finding.scope: Smooth connected complex d-folds, d>=2, over C with Q-coefficients; in particular simply-branched Hurwitz charts finite etale over M_{0,d+3}.
finding.statement: Let W be a smooth connected complex d-fold admitting a dominant, in particular finite etale, morphism to M_{0,d+3}, equivalently to the complement of the diagonals in (M_{0,4})^d. Then W admits a connected finite-etale cover W' with F^d Gr^W_{d+1} H_c^{d+1}(W';C) nonzero: pull back the degree-three Kummer cover C->M_{0,4} attached to y^3=x(x-1) in each of the d coordinates, take Q(-1) from one H_c^2(C) and H^{1,0}(Cbar) from the other d-1 factors, and observe that every locus removed along the way has dimension at most d-1, so the class survives by the FND-0165 corner together with F^d vanishing on the complement. Consequently no weight-equals-degree corner statement about such a base is etale-local, and no argument invariant under finite-etale refinement (transfer, averaging, monodromy-orbit counting, or descent along an atlas) can prove it.
